spans.s:
1. दून, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; going, moving.
—दून-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having gone.
2. दून. See under 1. दू, p. 426, col. 1.

2. दून, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. दून see under rt. 1.
दु at p. 418), burnt, inflamed; pained, afflicted,
distressed, fatigued; agitated.
—दून-मानस, अस्,
आ, अम्, distressed in mind.

दून दून. See col. 1. and rt. 1. दु at
p. 418.

दुन्वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, afflicting, causing pain or
sorrow, injuring.
दुन्वत् दुन्वत्. See rt. 2. दु, p. 418, col. 2.

दुन्दम दुन्दम, अस्, m. a sort of drum, =
दुन्दुभि below.

दुन्दु दुन्दु, उस्, m. (an onomatopoetic
word), a sort of drum; an epithet of Vasu-deva who
was the father of Kṛṣṇa; [cf. आनक-द्˚.]

दुन्दुभ दुन्दुभ, अस्, m. a species of water-
snake described as not venomous [cf. दुण्डुभ and
दुण्डुभि]; an epithet of Śiva; (आस्), m. pl., N.
of a Vedic school, = दुन्दुभि, a kind of drum
(occurring in the comp. अनक-द्˚).

दुन्दुभि दुन्दुभि, इस्, m. (fr. दुन्दु, imita-
tive sound), a sort of large kettle-drum; a sort of
poison; N. of the fifty-sixth year in the Jupiter cycle
of sixty years; an epithet of Varuṇa; Kṛṣṇa; N. of
an Asura; of a Rakṣas; of a son of Andhaka and
grandson of Anu; of a man considered as a son of
Śiva; (इस्), f. a drum; a particular throw of the dice
in gambling; twice three dots or spots on a die or
a pair of dice with three spots on each; (ई), f. ‘a
kettle-drum,’ N. of a Gandharvī; [cf. कर्ण-द्˚.]
—दुन्दुभि-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, having a neck like
a kettle-drum (an ox).
—दुन्दुभि-निर्ह्राद, अस्,
m. ‘having the sound of a kettle-drum,’ N. of a
Dānava.
—दुन्दुभि-वध, अस्, m., N. of the
eighty-ninth chapter of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.
—दुन्-
दुभि-स्वन, अस्, m. ‘emitting the sound of a kettle-
drum,’ a kind of magical formula or spell against the
evil spirits supposed to possess weapons.
—दुन्दुभि-
स्वर, अस्, m. ‘sounding like a kettle-drum,’ N. of
a man.
—दुन्दुभिस्वर-राज, अस्, m., N. of several
Buddhas.
—दुन्दुभीश्वर (˚भि-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a Buddha.
दुन्दुभिक, अस्, m. a kind of venomous insect.

दुन्दुभ्य, only in the comp. चक्र-दुन्दु-
भ्य (scil. मन्त्र), Ved. ‘relating to Cakra and
Dundubhi.’

दुन्दुमा दुन्दुमा, f. (an onomatopoetic
word), a particular sound, sound in general.

दुन्दुमाय, Nom. A. दुन्दुमायते, -यितुम्,
to sound.

दुन्दुमायित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded; (अम्), n. a
particular sound, sound.

दुन्दुमार दुन्दुमार, अस्, m. a sort of red
worm; the smoke of a house; a cat, = धुन्धु-
मार.
